verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai (HTTP 200) and a machine-readable openapi.json. The Computer docs themselves are served as raw .md pages (e.g. computer-mcp-server.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The .md.md 404 is only a double-suffix probe artifact, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt actually indexes the Computer-specific pages (its excerpt describes the broader Perplexity API docs), and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
